About.title: About Marwan Mohsen Supplements
About.p1: Marwan Mohsen Supplements was founded by athletes, for athletes — to make it simple to find protein, pre-workout, and everyday wellness products you can actually trust. Every formula is manufactured in a GMP-certified facility and checked by an independent lab before it ships.
About.p2: We work directly with accredited manufacturers to keep our supply chain short and our pricing fair, so you get premium quality without the premium markup.
About.p3: Whether you're chasing a new personal record or just trying to build a healthier daily routine, our team is here to help you find the right products for your goals.

Contact.title: Contact Us
Contact.subtitle: Questions about an order or a product? Send us a message and we'll respond within one business day.
Contact.name: Name
Contact.sent: Message sent — we'll be in touch within one business day.

Policies.shippingP1: Orders ship within 1-2 business days via tracked courier. Standard shipping typically arrives within 2-5 business days, with free shipping on all orders over $75.
Policies.shippingP2: We accept returns on unopened items in their original packaging within 30 days of delivery. Damaged or incorrect items are replaced free of charge — contact us with your order number and photos of the shipment.
Policies.shippingP3: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-10 business days of the return being received and inspected.
Policies.privacyP1: We collect the information you provide when creating an account or placing an order — name, email, shipping address, and order history. Payment details are processed directly by Stripe and are never stored on our servers.
Policies.privacyP2: We use your information solely to fulfill orders, provide customer support, and send order-related communications. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
Policies.privacyP3: You may request a copy of your data or ask us to delete your account at any time by contacting us.
Policies.termsP1: By purchasing from Marwan Mohsen Supplements, you agree to these terms of service. Products are intended for healthy adults; consult your physician before use if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication, or have a medical condition. These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA. Our products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Policies.termsP2: You must be at least 18 years old to purchase from our store. It is your responsibility to follow the usage instructions on each product's label.
Policies.termsP3: All sales are subject to our shipping and returns policy. Marwan Mohsen Supplements reserves the right to refuse service at our discretion.
